instruction: Add page numbers to the footer of this document.

parameters.window_name: The Wonders of Our Solar System.docx - LibreOffice Writer

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent explored File menu, Save Remote dialog, Manage services, and File > Send submenu to find collaboration options. Correctly identified that real-time collaborative editing is not supported in LibreOffice Writer desktop and declared the task infeasible.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate LibreOffice Writer menus, explore File menu options, interact with dialogs, identify infeasible tasks
metadata.task_rationale: Tests the model's ability to insert page numbers via Insert menu or Format menu. The original document has no footer page numbers. Requires navigating menus to add a page number field.
metadata.explanation: Task requires adding page numbers to the document footer. Getter reads the docx and checks footer XML for PAGE field markers or fldChar elements. Metric returns 1.0 if page numbers are found in any footer.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly checks footer XML for 'PAGE' field code and 'fldChar' elements, which are the standard OOXML markers for page number fields in docx footers.
Postconfig properly saves the document (Ctrl+S) before getter reads the file, ensuring state is persisted.
Metric correctly checks result.has_page_number and returns 1.0/0.0, fully covering the single instruction requirement.

Minor false positive risk: getter also returns True if any footer paragraph has non-empty text (lines 31-33), even if the text is not a page number. Since the original document has no footer, this is unlikely to cause issues in practice but is not strictly precise.
The 'fldChar' check is broad (matches any field character in footer, not just PAGE fields), though in footer context this is generally acceptable.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider removing the fallback paragraph text check (lines 31-33 in getter) to avoid false positives from non-page-number footer text.
For stricter verification, check specifically for PAGE field codes (e.g., look for 'instrText' containing 'PAGE') rather than any 'fldChar' element.
